# Background {#sec-background}
 The running back(RB) is a vital part of an offense and can leave a big impact on a game based on their performance. "Running Backs are a dynamic element in the offense, capable of rushing with the ball, receiving passes, and providing pass protection. They must exhibit a blend of speed, agility, and toughness to consistently gain yards on the ground or catch passes out of the backfield." (Nisay,2024)
